key_idea: Count the small squares in each shape. We only have 4.
steps: Shapes A, B, C and D each use 4 small squares.
Shape E, the plus sign, has 1 square in the middle and 4 around it: 1 + 4 = 5 squares.
We cannot make 5 squares from 4. So E cannot be made.

choice_feedback.A: This big square uses all 4 small squares, so it can be made.
choice_feedback.B: This long row uses all 4 small squares, so it can be made.
choice_feedback.C: This L shape uses all 4 small squares, so it can be made.
choice_feedback.D: This T shape uses all 4 small squares, so it can be made.
